title: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령 / queue:ADDENDUM:24424:20130323:00004:part:1/1
title_original: 재외공관 수입금 등 직접사용에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Addendum to the Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Its Affiliated Institutions <Presidential Decree No. 24424, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 7
Omitted.

Article 8 (Amendment of Other Statutes)
(1) through (9) Omitted.
(10) Part of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Direct Use of Revenues, etc. of Overseas Diplomatic Missions shall be amended as follows:
In Article 2 (1), the portion of Article 2 (2) other than its subparagraphs, and Articles 3 and 4, "Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade" (the former designation "외교통상부장관") shall in each case be replaced with "Minister of Foreign Affairs" (the designation "외교부장관").
(11) through (22) Omitted.
